title: War is Kind
author: Stephen Crane

authorInfo.bio: Stephen Crane was an American poet, novelist, and short story writer. Prolific throughout his short life, he wrote notable works in the Realist tradition as well as early examples of American Naturalism and Impressionism. He is recognized by modern critics as one of the most innovative writers of his generation.

description: "War is Kind" by Stephen Crane is a collection of poems written in the late 19th century. The book addresses the human experiences and tragedies associated with war, criticizing the glorification of violence while exploring themes of loss, suffering, and the harsh realities of battle.
